steps.text: *snip* *snip*...
*snip* *snip* *snip*...

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: I'm really jealous of you, Indigo. You've got such long, wonderful hair. You look amazing no matter how we style it.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: You think so? Why, I've never really thought of it that way.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: When I still lived by the seaside, my hair often got pretty damp because of how humid the air there is.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Tilt your head a little to the left, please—Okay, just like that. Don't move.
*snip* *snip*...

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: ...That stopped happening after I came to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: But the air has gotten a lot drier the last couple days, and it's gotten more difficult to take care of my hair.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: We've probably driven into a more arid area.
*snip* *snip*...

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Is that so...?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Right... I suppose that's probably why.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Because of how dry the air is, I've started having static electricity build up in my hair.
*snip*

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Even hair as pretty as yours? Is it serious?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Let me think... When I comb my hair in the morning, it's like...

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Like...?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: How do I describe this...?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Like D32 Steel.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: And sometimes, the shorter strands stand up like RMA70-12.
Bang!

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Did static build up in my hair again?

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Uh, no, that's not what it was...

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: —But I never knew you had such serious problems with static!

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Static can really hurt your hair. I've had a lot of trouble with it myself! You can't just leave it alone. You have to take care of it!

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Hm... Is it really so scary?

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: It's not a huge problem if it's only for a short while, but if it lasts, your hair will start to get dryer. You'll have to worry about breakage and hair loss, too.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Besides, Indigo, you're an Iberian. You just said you used to live by the sea, and your hair was often damp, right?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Oh, yes.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Then that's all the more reason not to ignore this. Your hair is used to humid environments, but you suddenly moved to a dry area. It'll upset your hair more than it does others'.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: I suggest you try these anti-static hair masks. They work really well keeping moisture in, and they're a great fit for your hair since it's on the dry side.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Why, this smells wonderful.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: How much?

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: No need to pay me.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: This is only a trial-size pack, so feel free to take it. If you think it works for you, you'll just need to file an application with the Logistics Department and they'll issue you regular ones for free.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Blue Poison? Glaucus? Why, hello there.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Hello, Indigo and Goldenglow.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Oh, Blue Poison... and Glaucus. Hello.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: I figured it might take you a little longer to cut Indigo's hair, so we brought you something to eat.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Thanks, you two. She just finished, actually. Let's have something to eat before the treatment.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Do you want some, Goldenglow? Blue Poison's really good at making desserts.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: I... I would love to try some, but this... this cake is colored lake blue... What exactly...?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Don't worry, it's nothing difficult to make. It gets its color from only one ingredient.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: One ingredient...? But what could possibly make your batter... um... this color?

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: It's not a very common ingredient, probably. The kind that you don't want to eat too much of in one go.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Eh—? Eh?! D-Does that mean—No, that can't be this color...

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Is this that thing that I keep hearing about...?

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Sorry, sorry. We're just pulling your leg.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: It's nothing as scary as you're thinking. Actually, it's quite normal.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: But what exactly gave it this color...?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: It's food coloring.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: —Coloring?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Naturally.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Blue Poison is very particular about the color of her desserts. If normal ingredients can't bring her ideas to life, she has no choice but to rely on food coloring.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: And here I was thinking if anything could've given it this color... it'd have to be something poisonous.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: So, um, is it okay I give this cake a try?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Okay... Here I go.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: (Munches)

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: (Eyes glitter in a golden glow)

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Can I have another?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Of course. Help yourself.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: We have some drinks here, too. Right, try some of this rose-colored one. It goes really well with desserts—

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Huh? What just happened?!

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: It looks like the power went out.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: I'll head outside and check out the circuits. You guys stay here. I'll be right back.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Why did the power go out all of a sudden? I-Is it because I didn't keep my static under control?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: I don't think you're the reason.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: I'm not?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: When you cut my hair just now, I didn't get shocked even once. That's why I don't think it was you.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Um... Actually, I did get shocked once...

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Speaking of static electricity, maybe some appliance in here short-circuited?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Why, that might just be—Oh, right!

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Is the power back?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: That's Indigo's Originium Arts.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: You're right. It doesn't look much like the lights we usually have here. The colors are so much warmer.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: But wouldn't this take a toll on your body?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: It's no problem.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: If you start feeling tired from casting your Arts, be sure to rehydrate and have something sweet.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: You don't have to worry. I used to be a lighthouse keeper. Even without any equipment, this much is nothing to write home about.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: I'll light up our surroundings. You should go back to your rooms and see if your appliances are still working.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Thanks, Indigo!

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Let's see. Hairdryer, hair clippers, heater...

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: There's a water kettle and a TV here...

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Blue Poison, can I have something to drink? I'm a little thirsty.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Help yourself. Remember, it's the rose one.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Why, thank you.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: The perm machine... Okay, that's all the appliances I have. They're all working fine.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Everything looks okay over here, too. It might be an external issue. We'll figure out what to do after Glau gets back.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Indigo, you can stop casting now. Come take a break.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Indigo?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: I'm more used to places with at least some light.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Light can give us hope. That's what my teacher always told me.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Why, when I used to be a lighthouse keeper, my teacher and I would try to keep the lights up for as long as we could.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: As long as you don't tire yourself out.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: It's not a big deal, like I said.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: This power cut reminds me... We used to have ones at night back when I was still in school in Victoria.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: That must have been inconvenient.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: I'm sure that's what my more zealous classmates thought. That's why they always lit candles to keep studying.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Though, to most of my classmates, the power cuts were basically just bonus holidays. Everyone would start chatting or do something else.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: We would chat by the candlelight and eat the snacks we snuck into the classrooms... Kind of like what we're doing right now, actually.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Then... should I put out the light?

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Oh, you don't have to. Without the candles, the classroom would have been pitch black. No one likes it that dark.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: I suppose you're right.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: I just asked. The power's not very stable right now. That's all. It'll be back very—

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: —And there we go.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Phew.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: We'd better get going now. Keep the cake.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Thanks, you two! And remember to come to me if you ever need a haircut!

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Glau will gladly take you up on the offer.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: But I'll have to pass. It's not very likely, but it's still somewhat dangerous to make physical contact with me. I have to be extra careful.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Is that so...

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Alright, off we go now.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Okay! I'll wash the cups and bring them back to you when we're done.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Thanks. Just leave them in front of my dorm room.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: I knew that Blue Poison was a master of poisons, but I never knew she was such a friendly person too.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Yeah, she really is.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: But when we first met, she held a crossbow bolt to my neck because she didn't know if I was a friend or a foe.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Oh, it's nothing, really. She pulled it back after we cleared our misunderstanding.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: She figured out I'm an Iberian from just a few questions, and then explained how somebody else must have mistook me for a bounty hunter.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: (Sounds kinda weird...)

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Okay, I'm finished with the cake.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Yep, that was tasty!

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Let's move on to the next step. Let me put on some hair protector—

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Indigo?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: I-I have a question.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Okay...?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: W-What color was the drink you just drank?

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Hm, let me think... Blue Poison said it was 'rose.'

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Oh, yours is light purple.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: What does it taste like? Can I try?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: D-Don't touch it.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: That one's...

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: (No, I can't. I can't tell her about it.)

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: (It took so much work just to improve her impression of Blue Poison.)

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Why, that's... Glaucus's drink. It was pretty dark earlier, so I couldn't see the color.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: So you two drank each other's drinks?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Right, that's it...

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: You seem kind of giddy... Did hers have alcohol in it perhaps?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: No, but... that's pretty close.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: You don't seem too well. Do you want to rest a little first?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Right, okay. I'll go get some rest...

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Alright. I'll take care of the tray and the cups—

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: N-No, don't! Don't touch Glaucus's drink.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Huh? Why not?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: (Well...)

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: I-I'll wash the cups. T-That's my own cup... so I-I'll wash it myself.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Are you sure you're feeling up to it?

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: You don't have to force yourself. I can do the dishes; you just go get some rest.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: W-Wait!

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Huh? Indigo?
*chugs the drink*

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Did you just drink the rest...?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: I... Sorry, but I... I need to pay a visit to Medical.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Medical?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Why, yes. I... I'm going... to Medical.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: P-Please don't touch the cup. Wait... Wait till I'm back...

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: You really don't look very well at all to me. How about I come with you?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: N-No need. I'm fine, really... P-Please just wait... wait here... After I get back, we... we need to work... on... um... my hair...
Indigo stands up and stumbles out of the room like she is absolutely inebriated.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: What is it with her...?

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Maybe she's having an allergic reaction to something in Glaucus's drink?

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: I need to go check on her—

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: Goldenglow? Where's Indigo?

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: Blue Poison?

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: She said she was going to pay Medical a visit and stumbled outside. I'm really worried about her. Is she okay?

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: You said she left on her own, unsteadily? She didn't pass out, did she?

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: No, she didn't... but I'm worried she might on her way there. She looked pretty smashed.

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: (Relaxed sigh)

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Where's the rest of her drink? I'll take care of it.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: You mean the light purple one?

steps.name: Glaucus
steps.text: Yeah, that one.

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: She drank half of it, then she looked like she was a little sick. I was going to pour it out and wash the cup, but she wouldn't let me. In the end, she even drank the rest of it.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: She drank the entire cup, and she could still trudge herself out of the room?

steps.name: Goldenglow
steps.text: More or less...

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: What should I say... She's really growing fast.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: (Chuckles)

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: The stuff in that drink isn't very strong. As long as she can make it out the door and to the Medical Department, there is nothing to worry about.

steps.name: Blue Poison
steps.text: But just to be safe, Glaucus, you should go to Medical and check on her—
Excuse me, are Operators Blue Poison and Glaucus here?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Are you feeling better?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Why, yes, much better.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Blue Poison's antidote works fast, huh.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Of course, you've gotten yourself poisoned way too many times now. It's no wonder you're building up a resistance against it.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Come to think of it, Blue Poison's usually pretty good at keeping her toxins under control, but you ingested a lot more this time than usual. What happened?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: That's because I made a mistake and drank Glaucus's drink.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Glaucus? From what I remember, she's practically immune to just about any kind of toxin.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Right, that's why when Blue Poison makes drinks for Glaucus, she often adds ingredients that would normally be toxic. To Glaucus, they're nothing more than quirky seasonings to spice things up.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Like how coffee's poisonous to some animals?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Yeah, that one.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Why, if someone else had drank it, their symptoms would have been much worse.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Most people wouldn't.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Do you want some more water?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: No thanks.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Hm... I vaguely remember running into somebody on my way to the Medical Department, and they brought me here...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: It was Operator Irene. She brought you in and left just as quickly.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Irene. Irene...

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: The Inquisitor?!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Right, it's the young—

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Excuse me for a moment!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Hey, you just got up! You should take it easy—Where are you even going?!

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: P-Phew... I'm still feeling a little dizzy...

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: No, I have to hurry—

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Irene?

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: You're quick to recover.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: It's true that I am more resistant to toxins—No, that's not what I wanted to talk about!

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Irene, please don't blame Blue Poison and Glaucus. They didn't do it on purpose!

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: (Sighs)

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: I was the one who drank Glaucus's drink by mistake. I'm the one to blame!

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: (Sighs even more heavily)

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Operator Indigo... I suggest you go back to Medical to rest a little longer.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Huh...? Why?

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: It seems your head isn't quite clear yet. You're obviously conflating me with whatever distorted image you have of the Inquisitors.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: They already told me how you drank something meant for Operator Glaucus.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: While it might perk her up because of her resistance to toxins, most people would be poisoned just by coming into contact with it.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Besides, there was that hair stylist who was sparking nonstop the whole time as witness. I have no doubt that this was nothing but an unfortunate little accident.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: So... they're safe, right?

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: What do I do with you...?

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: I'm an operator of Rhodes Island now. Even if you were intentionally poisoned, I don't have the authority to judge them on my own.

spans.text: I'm an operator of Rhodes Island now. Even if you
intentionally poisoned, I don't have the authority to judge them on my own.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: As both a Rhodes Island operator and an Iberian, I'm sure you know this, don't you?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: S-Sorry.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: It's okay. As long as you understand.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Now, you were just poisoned. You really should go back and get some rest.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Anything else?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: There are some lake blue cake crumbs on your lips.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: This... It was my duty to investigate the truth. I had to make sure...

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Ugh.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: (Quietly) At least... that's what I was thinking for the first slice.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: (Quietly) Of course, the stylist was on the verge of tears when she recommended it to me. That played a role, too.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: You may not like it when I put it like this, but you are... rather different from most other Inquisitors I've met.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Most Iberian Inquisitors I'm familiar with try their best to avoid contact with the Ægir, even if they know they're innocent.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: I admit I may be a bit of a special case in this regard.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: However, if I ever uncover any evil lurking here, I will personally see it eradicated.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: What about you, Operator Indigo?

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: I want to hear what you think about all this. As a Rhodes Island operator or as an Iberian. Doesn't matter.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Why, not much at all, really. All I know is that both of them are my friends, and I don't want to see them wrongfully accused because of me.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: I like your answer.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Goodbye, Operator Indigo. I enjoyed our conversation.

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Goodbye, Irene—

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Hold on, that fragrance...

steps.name: Indigo
steps.text: Did Goldenglow recommend you the same hair mask?
